control: Predictors trained through 2021, selected on 2022 H1; exact archived adapted-decoder forecasts.
refreshed: Expand training through the prior year, select CE-best on current H1. Reuse matching completed fits and generated tokens; train only 2024 seeds 29 and 43.
primary: Date-equal MAE for maximum high and minimum low, reported individually and equally averaged, at two and five days.
secondary: raw interval coverage and interval score
aggregation: Paired common usable stock-date inputs within each seed; dates equal, three seeds equal. Report individual seeds and targets. Block bootstrap 10 dates, 2000 replicates, seed 314159.
interpretation: Retain improvements effective across most tested scenarios, taking effect size and material regressions into account. Confidence intervals express uncertainty, not a requirement that every subgroup be significant. No post-result threshold tuning. This is retrospective research; both windows have been examined before. Refresh jointly changes recency, data quantity and selection period; does not isolate recency.
calibration: Retained as preferred research interval method. Existing coefficients are checkpoint-specific and are not transferred to refreshed predictors. This experiment measures point forecasts and raw distributions.
